description: This source file defines an enumeration AllowedSolution used in the context of root-finding algorithms within the Apache Commons Math library. The enum specifies constraints on the type of solutions acceptable based on their relation to the actual root, such as any side, left side, right side, below side, or above side.

classes.name: AllowedSolution
classes.description: Enumeration specifying the kinds of solutions that are acceptable in root-finding algorithms, controlling whether solutions are allowed on any side, or restricted to being less than, greater than, below, or above the actual root.
